findings.description: The supplied diff is one CHANGELOG.md hunk labelled 'part 1/2' and every visible line is context; there is no '+' or '-' line. None of the code the implementation report describes (implement-gate.sh active_skill evidence, the claude-opus-5-5 catalog entry and its 180K ceiling, model-permissions.yaml rows, the 5-family regexes in model-adapter and Flatline, the recall grader parser) is in the diff. This review therefore covers only the FR-2 changelog prose.
findings.failure_mode: If this envelope is read as a dissent on the Sprint 4 code, verdict quality is overstated: nothing here confirms or refutes the code changes, and a defect in any of the listed files would pass unseen.
findings.suggested_fix: Re-run the dissent with --diff-range <base>...<head> over the Sprint 4 commits so the content preparer sends the code files, and check that lib-content.sh's partial view did not place the CHANGELOG's changed lines in an unsent part.

findings.cross_file_justification: CHANGELOG.md is the only diff-touched file and the report says it documents the Sprint 4 pin changes; the conflict is between two claims in the same report that the changelog is meant to record (the deep-thinker retarget and the Flatline allowlist assertion).
findings.description: The implementation report states that the deep-thinker pin is now gemini-3.1-pro and, in the same report, that the Flatline allowlist test 'still forbids the bare gemini-3.1-pro' because only the -preview id is listed. If any Flatline path (flatline-proposal-review, flatline-validate-learning, flatline-learning-extractor are all listed as re-pinned to aliases) resolves deep-thinker to that bare id, validate_model rejects it.
findings.failure_mode: A Flatline skill pinned to deep-thinker fails model validation on every invocation, or silently falls back to another model, after this merge.
findings.suggested_fix: Either add the bare gemini-3.1-pro to the Flatline allowlist and update flatline-model-allowlist.bats, or point deep-thinker at the listed -preview id. Add a test that resolves each pinned alias and passes the result through validate_model.

findings.description: Two defaults change meaning for existing configurations with only an upgrade note as the signal: budget_cents becomes a per-voice cap (a dissent can now spend up to twice the configured value, since cost_usd is the sum of two voices), and on a single-family host every security_audit is DEGRADED_SECURITY_REVIEW until companion_voice: false is added to the block.
findings.failure_mode: Operators who set budget_cents as a run ceiling overspend by up to 2x with no change on their side; single-family hosts see every security audit degraded after upgrade until they discover the opt-out.
findings.suggested_fix: Emit a one-time WARN when a block has no explicit companion_voice key and a companion is planned, and either rename the knob (budget_cents_per_voice) or keep budget_cents as the run total and split it across voices.

findings.description: The run lock fails open in several enumerated cases: mkdir fails for a reason other than contention, flock exits with a code other than 1, flock is absent during a dead-holder takeover, or the takeover section cannot be opened. In each case the run proceeds unguarded for the same (sprint, gate) with only a WARN.
findings.failure_mode: Two unguarded runs move each other's envelope and sidecars aside as .prev or hit workdir_unavailable mid-run; verdict-derive.sh then reports dissent_aborted for a run that completed, or the review adopts an envelope from the other run's voice set.
findings.suggested_fix: Fail closed with a distinct status when the lock cannot be established, behind an explicit opt-in to run unguarded. Write the envelope to a run_tag-suffixed path and rename atomically so a concurrent run never observes a half-written file.

findings.description: To keep the prompt off argv, the gemini adapter forces GEMINI_SANDBOX=false and overrides an operator's tools.sandbox setting. The agy adapter leaves the whole prompt on argv, readable through /proc/<pid>/cmdline and subject to E2BIG above roughly 128 KiB; unlike gemini's argv path it has no stated size refusal.
findings.failure_mode: If the gemini hop does not also disable tool execution, a prompt-injected diff can drive unsandboxed tool calls on the operator host. An agy companion hop on a large chunk fails at execve and the voice is dropped.
findings.suggested_fix: Confirm the gemini hop runs with tools disabled or in a read-only approval mode and document that beside the GEMINI_SANDBOX note. Give agy the stdin path, or at minimum the 124 KiB refusal that gemini's argv path has.
